preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n where 2 ≤ n ≤ 100, representing the length of the unknown string s.
The total number of lines in stdin is exactly 2n-2, where n is the length of the unknown string.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) >= 1 and len(line) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) - 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the 2n-2 lines (excluding the first line) is a string of length between 1 and n-1, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(line.islower() and line.isalpha() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the 2n-2 strings consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: len({len(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]}) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) - 1
preconditions.description: For each length l from 1 to n-1, there are exactly two strings of length l in the input.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly 2n-2 characters, one for each input string (excluding the first line).

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'P', 'S'} for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either 'P' (prefix) or 'S' (suffix).

postconditions.expression: len([c for c in stdout if c == 'P']) == len([c for c in stdout if c == 'S'])
postconditions.description: The number of 'P's in the output string equals the number of 'S's.

postconditions.expression: all(any((stdin.splitlines()[1:][i] == s[:len(stdin.splitlines()[1:][i])] or stdin.splitlines()[1:][i] == s[-len(stdin.splitlines()[1:][i]):]) for s in possible_strings) for i in range(len(stdout))) if (possible_strings := [s for s in possible_strings if all((stdin.splitlines()[1:][i] == s[:len(stdin.splitlines()[1:][i])] or stdin.splitlines()[1:][i] == s[-len(stdin.splitlines()[1:][i]):]) for i in range(len(stdout))) if (possible_strings := [s for s in all_possible_strings if all((stdin.splitlines()[1:][i] == s[:len(stdin.splitlines()[1:][i])] or stdin.splitlines()[1:][i] == s[-len(stdin.splitlines()[1:][i]):]) for i in range(len(stdout)))]) else True)
postconditions.description: There exists at least one string s of length n such that for every i, the i-th input string is either a prefix of s (if the i-th output character is 'P') or a suffix of s (if the i-th output character is 'S').
